column4: the exchange amplitudes of the Vorton-Scalar in 90 pair channels (both spacetimes, three momenta, 13 angles: 1170 rows) computed again with the frame matrices agree with every number of the file data/pair_channel_kernel.csv of the main project to the digits printed there (1170 rows compared). For fields that do not depend on x5, x6, x7 the amplitude of a channel on the deflating spacetime is the flat amplitude times the square of the coupling of the moment
the amplitudes of the hidden-axis channel reproduce the closed forms of the main project (largest deviation 1.1e-15)

the quartic invariant of the gap matrix of the four vector pairs, Tr[(M M^dagger)^2]/8 = 2 (sum |Delta^a|^2)^2 - |eta_ab Delta^a Delta^b|^2 with the frame metric of x0, x5, x6, x7, holds on both deflating spacetimes (largest deviation 2.1e-14); in coordinate components Delta_t = b_t(x4) Delta^t the same form reads with the metric g_tt of the moment

the field that a static source builds up from zero approaches exp(gsum x4)/(k^2 + M^2): after tau = gsum x4 = 20 the relative difference is 1.9e-5 4.3e-6 2.4e-5 3.5e-5 for (k^2 + M^2, gsum) = (1, 0.2), (0.25, 0.2), (1, 1), (4, 0.5) (transient proportional to exp(-tau/2)). The potential between two fermions at rest is therefore the Yukawa potential of the unshifted mass m_s with the strength alpha_VS of the moment

a mode of the Vorton-Scalar that does not depend on x5, x6, x7 goes as exp(sigma x4) with sigma = gsum/2 +- sqrt(gsum^2/4 - k^2 - M^2): it oscillates if and only if k^2 + M^2 > gsum^2/4, and its amplitude then grows as exp(gsum x4/2) (the weighted field has constant amplitude: the number of quanta is conserved). The phase mode (M = 0) does not oscillate for k < gsum/2; the radial mode oscillates at every k if m_s > gsum/2 (table data/scalar_zero_modes.csv)
